name: Identify objects, species, or concepts based on descriptions
description: Users asked to identify the specific name, species, type, or classification of objects, animals, images, and concepts based on visual descriptions, physical characteristics, or contextual clues. These requests varied from identifying real-world items like clothing and tools to recognizing fictional characters, art styles, and symbols.
